line: America lost 1.3 million bee colonies, yet the count rose 6 %: a news short that works with the sound off.
line_cn: 美国一年死掉 130 万箱蜜蜂，总数却涨了 6%：静音也能看懂的新闻。

motion.cuts: camera-led cuts: slide or push-through on motion

camera.move: Cuts on a 120 BPM half-beat grid (every cut at a multiple of 0
camera.expresses: 5 s). Footage shots 1.5–3 s; data cards and documents 3–4.5 s; a shot that holds a comparison stays until every item has been fully on screen ≥ 2.5 s.
A caption can run over two shots (picture changes, words don't); captions change at most every ~2.5 s even when shots change every 1.5 s. Reading time, not shot length, sets the caption clock.
footage (feeling) → the number on a card → the document line that says it → the consequence. Never a number without its source tag in the same shot.

labels: Chinese line: Noto Sans SC 900, 88 px (verdict lines 110 px), ivory #F7F5EF, 20 px dark soft shadow. Split into 2–3 chunks with | in the timeline; each chunk slams 0.12 s after the previous: scale 1.3 → 1 in 0.13 s (back ease, overshoot 1.6), opacity full in 0.04 s.
Keyword: {…} inside a chunk; a honey-yellow block #FFC21A wipes left → right in 0.12 s behind it, text turns ink #0E0E0C. One keyword per caption, at most.
English line: Inter Tight 500, 33 px, ivory, fades and rises 10 px in 0.18 s, 0.1 s after the first chunk. It is the spoken line (numbers as digits), not a translation of the Chinese.

One line per language, always. If either language would wrap, split the sentence into two captions. A caption is on screen ≥ 1.8 s and ideally ≥ the spoken line + 0.6 s; the Chinese is a paraphrase short enough to read in that time (≤ ~14 characters).

native_moves.name: Frame-4 hook
native_moves.does: kicker line, then a giant number in a yellow block rolling to its value in 0.45 s, then the unit and the subject word (hook()).

native_moves.name: Chunk slam with one yellow keyword
Proportion by darkness
native_moves.does: a yellow line sweeps across the footage to the percentage; what it passed goes grey and dark; the figure appears on the dark side (shotHalf()). Works for any "X % of …".

native_moves.name: The document says it
native_moves.does: headline or sentence highlighted from PDF bbox coordinates, then the number popped as a yellow block beside the paper (paper(), shotDoc6(), shotQuote()).

native_moves.name: Freeze and question
native_moves.does: the image stops on the viewer's question, music cut to silence (shotFreeze()).

native_moves.name: Ledger split
native_moves.does: two counters racing side by side, the difference stamped after both settle (shotSplit()).

native_moves.name: Lit grid
native_moves.does: three ways / three causes, each panel lighting on its word (shotGrid()).

native_moves.name: Punch and circle
native_moves.does: 0.3 s punch-in on the culprit, a circle drawn round it, a leader to its name and its Latin name (shotSem()).

native_moves.name: Map to ground
native_moves.does: the map pushes into a region, then a photo of that place grows out of the region's outline (shotMap()).
